name: flash-wake-on-input
title: Wake Storage on Input
summary: A button press starts the flash storage immediately.
description: Starts the flash storage when you press a button, so that the first song starts sooner.
details: After a long pause, a button press starts the storage immediately.
Thus the storage is ready when you choose a song.
After a start, the storage stays on for the time that you select. The iPod does not examine the storage again during this time.
A turn of the click wheel does not start the storage.
requires: Flash storage, for example an iFlash, CompactFlash or SSD adapter. Do not use this patch with the original hard drive.
notes: Use this patch together with SSD Mode if the first song after a long pause starts late. Set the same Storage Time in the two patches.
hdd_warning: This patch is for flash storage. On the original hard drive, each button press after a long pause starts the disk, and the disk turns for the selected time. This uses more battery and causes more wear.

choices.title: 1 minute
choices.description: The storage stops soon after each use. This uses the least battery. The first song after a pause can start late.

choices.title: 2 minutes
choices.description: The storage stops soon after each use. The first song after a pause can start late.

choices.title: 5 minutes
choices.description: A balance of battery use and fast starts.

choices.title: 10 minutes
choices.description: A balance of battery use and fast starts.

choices.title: 30 minutes
choices.description: The default. Songs start fast after most pauses.

choices.title: 60 minutes
choices.description: Songs start fast after long pauses. This uses the most battery.
